text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The liquor store run by Biwa Hayahide's
family is
holding a party to celebrate the
anniversary of its
founding, and I've
been invited.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah, this party is amazing! I'm... Hic! Sniffle... I'm sho gwad Hayahide's hard work paid ooooff!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You're so noisy. I knew this would happen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Come on, clean up your face. This is a

celebration, so laugh like an idiot. Just
the same
as you always do.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWAAAGH! You're sh-sho nice,
Taishiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen Taishin act this lively... I
suppose
it's thanks to Ticket and
Hayahide's influence.

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Let's raise a toast to ourselves, the BNW
mothers!
Cheers to Hayahide's efforts...
and to their
friendship!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Quite a number of guests are becoming
tipsy. This
could lead to someone falling
ill...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Gah... The children are running around.
If
someone were to slip and fall on this
stone
paving, they could get badly
hurt...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The workers are busier than expected,
too. If a
glass or plate were to fall, the
shards would pose
a risk to the guests...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sir, I believe you would benefit from a
short
break. I'll bring you a refreshing
glass of water.

text_block_list.name: Tipsy Guest
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh... You're right. Sorry for the
hassle!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Children, how about a game of Dirt
Night over in
the traditional tatami
room? There's plenty of
snacks and
juice!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Really?! I wanna play!
All right guys,
let's go!
Yeah, come on!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, to reduce the staff's workload... I
suppose
the solution is to increase their
number.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...That's it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian, I have a request. I want you to
help with
setting and cleaning the
tables.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Already done. I also revised the
table-setting
process. That's what you
would've done, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see! Brian, you're a lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the anniversary party continues
without a
hitch...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that's the last of the cleaning
done.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Everything went according to schedule.
All issues
were resolved, and the party
proceeded as
planned. I fulfilled my role
as organizer. Though...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if everyone enjoyed
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Hayahide's Mother
text_block_list.text: What are you saying?! Isn't that obvious?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: M-Mother... Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Hayahide's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You've always been a stickler for the
details. I
remember when you would
make Brian take a first
aid kit and who
knows what else to her archery
lessons...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: M-Mother, not that story again!

text_block_list.name: Hayahide's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Brian always had
something on
hand to patch up any
injuries!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hayahide's Mother
text_block_list.text:
And the archery teacher quickly
remembered her
face because of that
yellow hat. Hehe, isn't that
right, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Liquor Store Worker
text_block_list.text:
We owe so much to you as well! The
extra help at
the store was a constant
lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Liquor Store Worker
text_block_list.text:
And the customers always complimented
how
neatly the bottles were packaged!

text_block_list.name: Liquor Store Worker
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention all the new delivery
routes you
planned out for us. And
you're still a huge help
even now!

text_block_list.name: Inn Proprietress
text_block_list.text:
My grandchild was so happy to receive
an
apology letter from you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (...Oh. I understand now.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(That day, I realized that my
shortcomings could
also become my
strengths.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(That my overly anxious mind has its
uses. But...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here has already long
accepted me for
who I am.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone. Organizing this
party has
taught me something very
important.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And that is how to view my flaws as
unique
strengths, rather than
weaknesses. I feel more
capable of
accepting myself and—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: See you later, Ms. Big Head!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Big what?! Wait right there, you rascals! That's no way to address your elder!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose that's another "unique
strength" of
hers.
